prompt: What is the name of the Australian novelist who is one of only five writers to have won the Booker Prize twice and also won the Jerusalem Prize?
answer: The Australian novelist is **J. M. Coetzee**. He won the Booker Prize twice—for *Life & Times of Michael K* and *Disgrace—and received the Jerusalem Prize in 1987.
